h: Rudeboy reportedly responds to claims he was a dancer amid the P-Square feud
p: Rudeboy has reportedly addressed claims that he started out as a dancer, as the dispute with his brother continues to play out in public. He is said to have given his own account of his early career.
more: The brothers' split has drawn comment from fans and fellow artists.
